statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (the canvas labelled '72v (part)' that shows a single wheel with a pair of scales; full page and one full-resolution crop of the inner part). I took this wheel to be f72v1 because I count 10 figures in its inner ring, and of the three f72v pages only f72v1 has 10 label lines in its second group (20 in the first); the other two wheels are on the neighbouring canvas. Centre: a balance with two hanging pans and blue touches, a short word in another script beneath. Two rings of nude standing figures without tubs, each with a star and a short label: 10 inner (counted), 20 outer (from the label group; not securely counted on the faint drawing). One outer figure near the top wears a crown. A round hole in the vellum cuts the right side. Labels assigned from line ids and unit codes only, words not read; clockwise from the figure at the top by my assumption, so ids may be rotated by a constant within a ring. Ring figures carry generic features only.
